_why: The brand identity, in the one format both loaders read. app.config.ts is evaluated by plain Node, which cannot require theme.ts, so every value the NATIVE side needs lives here and theme.ts imports it rather than repeating it: the two grounds (adaptive icon, splash), the accent (every accent variant in both schemes is derived from it in theme.ts), and the typeface (theme.ts applies fontFamily; app.config.ts embeds exactly these files under exactly that name). A rebrand edits this file. src/__tests__/brand-font.test.ts fails if theme.ts and app.config.ts ever disagree about the font.
